beats.title: the chase tears through the school

beats.text: Excuse me! Coming through! *running pass Sonia*
Cream?!
Blaze!
Sis!
Manic... don't tell me you used that male spray ag-
*notices smell* Actually you smell nice! But why are they-
No time for chatting, we've gotta find out what's going on!
Quickly before they catch up!
What are you crazy? A race in the- *notices Tails and Sonic catching up*
WAIT FOR ME, MANIC! *follows him*
Sonic! Why aren't you running at super sonic speed?!
Dude, I only do that when I'm late for class cause no one's around the corridors, but loads of people are at the moment so I don't wanna crash into anyone!
I have an idea! How about we split up?
GUYS, WAIT UP! *running with Silver but far behind*
NO YOU IDIOT! IT'S YOUR FAULT FOR CRASHING INTO SILVER!
HE WAS IN THE WAY!
HEY, IT'S NOT MY FAULT THAT CREAM ACCIDENTALLY CRASHED INTO ME!
GUYS, CAN'T WE JUST LISTEN TO THE GIRL FOR ONCE?!
THIS IS WHY I LIKE TAILS! AT LEAST HE LISTENS!
CAN YOU ALL JUST STOP YELLING AND LET ROUGE TELL US THE PLAN?!
Alright, I know that they're heading to the Performance Stadium, there are loads of entrances.
We can split up in 2's and take an entrance. Sonic you go with Tails, I'll go with Shadow and Knuckles go with Silver
WHAT DID SHE SAY?!
SHE SAID SPLIT UP CAUSE THEY'RE HEADING TO THE PERFORMANCE STADIUM!
ALRIGHT, SILVER THIS WAY! *he runs through another corridor*
YOU GUYS TAKE THE MAIN ENTRANCE! LET'S GO ROUGE *grabs her hand and runs through another corridor*
I see Manic and Sonia chasing after them too!
Man, I'm starting to think how many people are after them
Hehe, you're so funny, Espio *walking with Espio*
Heh heh, good to know that!
Uhm... what just happened?
I think something's up!
C'mon, we should check it out *grabs her hand and runs*
*pant* Now Tikal and Espio are after them! *pant*
Man, where does Cream get all her energy from?!
*runs into the Performance Stadium* BLAZE, SHUT THE DOOR BEHIND YOU!
ON IT! *runs into stadium and shuts door behind her*
WHOOOAAAAA! *sliding across the corridor*
Espio! The door's shut
Don't worry! We'll take another entrance! *runs with Cream through another corridor*
Phew.. *sinks to ground* *pant* never knew *pant* I could run SO much. *pant* in my life..
Oh to me, that was nothing!
Huh?! *turns around*
So, which one of you's are gonna give me an explaination? Or are you just gonna keep on running and still get caught by me?
